name: Meta E5 Loop
blurb: Meta's software engineering loop: a behavioral round, two coding rounds, a large-scale system design, and a product-flavored design round.

rounds.title: Behavioral
rounds.focus: Impact, collaboration, and driving projects to completion. Push for the candidate's individual role and the measurable outcome.

rounds.title: Coding I
rounds.focus: Two-problems-in-45 pace: correct, communicated, and complexity-aware. Probe edge cases.

rounds.title: Coding II
rounds.focus: Optimal solution and a clean second-problem follow-up; watch how they recover from a wrong first approach.

rounds.title: System Design
rounds.focus: Product-scale system: data model, hot paths, and tradeoffs. Deep-dive one component's failure modes.

rounds.title: ML System Design
rounds.focus: Ranking/recommendation-style ML system: features, training/serving split, and evaluation. Probe metric choice and feedback loops.
